# Johnson Controls showcases AI-enabled security innovations for more resilient operations at GSX 2026


Share


-
-
-
-


- *New **exacqVision, C•CURE IQ,** and **Managed Services** simplify and strengthen enterprise security.*


****** **MILWAUKEE, Sept. 9, 2026** –[Johnson Controls](https://www.johnsoncontrols.com/) (NYSE: JCI), a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, is returning to exhibit at[Global Security Exchange (GSX) 2026](https://www.gsx.org/) in Atlanta from Sept. 14-16. At Booth 1633, Johnson Controls will showcase new innovations and Managed Services designed to help organizations improve visibility across facilities, accelerate incident response, strengthen operational resilience and maintain continuity across increasingly connected and mission-critical environments.


GSX 2026 takes place against a backdrop of digital transformation reshaping enterprise security and increasing pressure on teams to do more with limited resources.[Nearly 50% of physical security teams](https://www.genetec.com/binaries/content/assets/genetec/reports/report_en_state-of-physical-security-2026_web.pdf) identify AI as a key priority and[43% of organizations](https://www.genetec.com/binaries/content/assets/genetec/reports/report_en_state-of-physical-security-2026_web.pdf) plan to target hybrid security architectures. To help organizations strengthen security operations and improve resilience, Johnson Controls will spotlight:


- **exacqVision 26.2** to help security teams identify events faster, improve situational awareness and make more informed decisions through AI-driven insights
- **Software House C•CURE IQ 3.20** to streamline security operations through enhanced workflows, insights and deployment flexibility
- **Managed Services** to augment security teams with centralized expertise, continuous monitoring and operational support
- **Proactive Video Solutions** to improve situational awareness while supporting safety, compliance and operational objectives


"As physical security, building systems and digital technologies become increasingly connected, organizations need greater visibility and control across their operations," said Al Young, vice president & general manager, Security, Americas, Johnson Controls. "We are focused on delivering innovations and managed services that help customers respond faster, improve operational resilience and protect the people, facilities and critical assets they depend on every day."


**exacqVision 26.2**


The newest iteration of video management system for commercial buildings, exacqVision 26.2 strengthens security intelligence and operational awareness while making AI-driven insights easier for teams to access and act upon. The update delivers a redesigned web client, providing dashboard-level insights across camera fleets, helping teams to quickly identify events, monitor facilities, and respond more effectively.


**Software House C•CURE IQ 3.20**


**** GSX will mark the release of


**Software House C•CURE IQ 3.20** , an update to the modern web-based security platform that combines video management, incident response, reporting, and analytics into a single experience. This update enables custom insights based on end-user needs, creating prioritized, spatially aware, actionable insights tailored to security and smart building requirements. The update also provides the flexibility to deploy


**C•CURE IQ Video** as an entirely standalone solution. This simplifies deployment and helps security teams investigate incidents faster, reduce operational complexity and make more informed decisions from a unified view of security operations.


The company will demonstrate additional solutions at GSX 2026, including:


- **KTES2** , a next-generation smart video intercom solution to modernize tenant, visitor, and property access while leveraging the proven security of the Kantech EntraPass platform.
- **C•CURE IQ Mobile App & C•CURE Cloud** , new capabilities within the C•CURE IQ platform to enhance accessibility through a mobile interface and build cloud scalability.
- **Illustra Multisensor Cameras** , introducing three new Panoramic Camera, Multisensor Fixed, and 360 Varifocal solutions.
- **The KT-40 Anniversary Kit** , a special kit exclusively available at GSX to commemorate the 40th anniversary of the Kantech solution suite that packages controllers, readers, and credentials capabilities.


C•CURE IQ 3.20 is now available, while exacqVision 26.2 will be available later in 2026.


Beyond its latest software and security platform advancements, Johnson Controls will also demonstrate service offerings that help organizations strengthen day-to-day security operations. Through **Managed Services** , organizations can access centralized monitoring, security expertise and operational support through a dedicated security operations center. The offering helps customers maintain continuous coverage, improve incident response and focus internal resources on higher-value priorities.


Johnson Controls will also display **Proactive Video Solutions** , which combine intelligent analytics with expert monitoring to help organizations identify potential risks earlier, improve situational awareness and support safer, more resilient operations across their facilities.


To learn more about the latest in Johnson Controls security solutions and Managed Services suite, stop by booth 1633 at GSX 2026 and visit:[https://www.johnsoncontrols.com/security](https://www.johnsoncontrols.com/security) .
